title: Positive and nodal solutions for the Minkowski mean curvature equation: multiplicity and asymptotics
summary: We consider the Dirichlet problem for the mean curvature operator in Minkowski space, \[ -\operatorname{div}\left(\frac{\nabla u}{\sqrt{1-|\nabla u|^2}}\right) = λu + μh(x,u) \quad \text{in } Ω, \qquad u = 0 \quad \text{on } \partialΩ, \] in a bounded domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^N$, where $λ, μ$ are real parameters, and the nonlinearity $h$ is superlinear at $u = 0$. In particular, we study the combined effect of the parameters $λ,\,μ$ on the multiplicity of solutions.
